title: Survival Time in Cold Water
description: Time to exhaustion and death for humans in cold water. This tool helps estimate survival times based on water temperature.

components.content:
## Survival Time in Cold Water

Time to exhaustion and death for humans in cold water.

![Cold water - survival time](static/docs/documents/1567/cold-water-survival.jpg "Cold water - survival time")

The survival time for a person in cold water is limited as indicated in the table below.

outputs.label: Exhaustion Time
outputs.formula: inputs.water_temp_f >= 80 ? 999 : inputs.water_temp_f > 70 ? 7.5 : inputs.water_temp_f > 60 ? 4.5 : inputs.water_temp_f > 50 ? 1.5 : inputs.water_temp_f > 40 ? 0.75 : inputs.water_temp_f > 32.5 ? 0.375 : 0.25

outputs.label: Death Time
outputs.formula: inputs.water_temp_f >= 80 ? 999 : inputs.water_temp_f > 70 ? 20 : inputs.water_temp_f > 60 ? 21 : inputs.water_temp_f > 50 ? 3.5 : inputs.water_temp_f > 40 ? 2 : inputs.water_temp_f > 32.5 ? 1 : 0.625
